integrity: Exact all-integer proof and standalone rational checker. Finite tests are supplementary. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed unit-edge shortest-path metric on K_{3,n}, n>=3. Not a worst-over-weights claim; general m-by-n, minimum embedding dimension, and exhaustive historical priority are not settled.
title: Exact \(\ell_1\) distortion and cut rigidity of unit-edge \(K_{3,n}\) metrics
